Churning, flying, black, oily cloud with a single square- pupiled eye in the center. Denizens of Negative Plane.

AC 15, HP 62, ATK 3 tentacle (near) +8 (2d8 + annihilation), MV near (burrow, fly), S +6, D +5, C +4, I -2, W +4, Ch +4, AL C, LV 13

Annihilation. Kills plants and decays bodies within close. Creatures reduced to 0 HP by tentacle die, disintegrated.

Aura of Dubiety. If a divine caster within double near fails to cast a spell, oblivion can subvert the spell, cast it (spell +8), and choose the target.

Pure Evil. Immune to lightning. Only damaged by magical sources. Can be targeted by turn undead.
